Name: Clear Farm Debris
Author: golanggopher
Description: Farm gets cleared of trees, bushes, rocks, weeds, stumps, logs, boulders, grass, and random event objects.  Perfect for new saves and using other mods where you dont need the resources to build your farm out.

Downloads.Description: This fixes the bug that eliminates crops by accident

Manifest.Name: ClearFarmDebris
Manifest.Description: This mod will clear all debris from your farm so you can begin building stuff quick on new save states.  1.0.1 Fixes bug clearing crops
Manifest.Author: David Renne
